name: US equity stress
summary: S&P 500 falls 4.3% on 5 Nov, its worst day since 2025, as chip stocks plunge; VIX 28
state: The S&P 500 fell about 4.3% on 5 Nov and the Nasdaq 5.5%, closing in correction, as the Philadelphia semiconductor index dropped 12% (Yahoo Finance). The S&P is 6.0% below its 52-week high and the VIX closed at 28.2, both inside the Watch band and below the VIX 30 Alert line. October payrolls are due on 6 Nov.
for_you: Sharp equity falls hit pension and investment values in the short term; volatility often stays high for days after a move this size.
rubric_hit: VIX 25.6 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 5.65% ≥ 5% Watch line

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Stock market today, 5 Nov: Nasdaq enters correction

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
